import socket
import threading
import random

    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.settimeout(1)
    sock.bind((host, port))
    sock.listen()

    return sock

    sock = create_connection(host, port)
    node = threading.Thread(target=create_connection)
    node.daemon = True
    node.start()
    return node
